summary: Frontend-only verification after Vercel deploy fixes. CI=true production build passes (yarn build, exit 0, compiled successfully, no ESLint-as-error failures) - so the reported Vercel build blocker (apostrophe escape) is resolved. All requested routes (/, /contact, /blog, /blended-worlds, /sellerie-garcia) render with zero console/page errors. Header + footer Shop links point to https://asskshop.bigcartel.com with target=_blank/rel=noopener (desktop + mobile menu). Footer Blog link navigates to /blog. Homepage 'Projets Clients' carousel has 6 cards, prev/next arrows scroll (0 -> 466 -> 0) and card click navigates to /sellerie-garcia. Blog list -> blog post deep route renders. Contact multi-step quote wizard advances step 1 -> step 2 correctly. Found 3 real defects: footer 'À Propos' -> /about hits 404, SEO component prop-API mismatch making 11 pages inherit the homepage title/description, and package.json homepage='.' which will break asset loading on multi-segment routes (e.g. /blog/:slug) in the Vercel deployment.

ui_bugs.issue: 'À Propos' links to /about, but the route defined in App.js is /a-propos -> renders 404 page

SEO component signature is ({page, customTitle, customDescription}) but 11 pages pass title=/description= props. Those props are ignored, so /contact, /blog, /blog/:slug, /blended-worlds, /sellerie-garcia, /coachella-2k24, /liberty-van, /entreprise-lesly, /club-football-laforest, /realisations all render the homepage title 'ASSK Studio | Graphiste Freelance...' and homepage description/keywords. Verified live: /blended-worlds title is the generic home title.
HomePage.js renders no <SEO> component at all; title/meta come only from public/index.html (no og/twitter tags, no LocalBusiness schema on home)
Missing data-testid on carousel prev/next arrows (only aria-label), carousel cards, dots, footer links and quote-form step options - reduces test robustness
data-testid generated from link name contains a space and accent: 'nav-à propos' / 'mobile-nav-à propos'. Prefer slugified testids.

integration_issues.issue: package.json has "homepage": "." so build/index.html references ./static/js/main.*.js. With the SPA rewrite to /index.html, a hard load of a 2-segment route such as /blog/graphiste-clermont-ferrand resolves assets to /blog/static/... -> 404 -> blank page. Set homepage to "/" (or remove it) for Vercel.

issues: 'Continuer' button in disabled state uses very light blue on white (low contrast); acceptable but borderline

action_items: Fix Footer 'À Propos' href: /about -> /a-propos (or add an /about redirect route)
Fix SEO prop API: accept title/description (or update all 11 call sites to customTitle/customDescription) - currently all inner pages share the homepage SEO metadata
Change package.json homepage from '.' to '/' so hashed assets load on nested routes after Vercel deploy
Add data-testid attributes to carousel controls/cards and quote-form options
critical_code_review_comments: SEO.js accepts page/customTitle/customDescription while most pages pass title/description - silent prop drop, no runtime error, so it went unnoticed. Consider PropTypes/TS or a single normalized prop.
homepage='.' in CRA + SPA rewrites is a known deployment footgun for nested routes; only 1-segment routes accidentally work.
Header nav uses link.name for data-testid, producing non-slug testids with accents/spaces.
HomePage.js is large (>600 lines) with inline carousel logic using document.getElementById; extract into a reusable Carousel component with refs instead of direct DOM queries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pure frontend app, no backend. CI=true build verified passing (log /tmp/build.log). Verified: all 5 requested routes, Shop external links (header desktop+mobile, footer), footer Blog link, homepage carousel arrows/cards, blog->post deep route, contact wizard step1->step2. Not tested: EmailJS actual submission (would send a real email), /a-propos, /graphisme, /sites-web, /modelisation-3d, remaining project pages. Open bugs: footer /about 404, SEO prop mismatch, package.json homepage='.'.
rca_of_the_issue: Vercel build failure itself is fixed (CI=true build compiles clean). However the deployment can still render blank pages for nested routes because CRA emits relative asset paths due to package.json homepage='.'; combined with the vercel.json SPA rewrite, /blog/<slug> requests /blog/static/js/main.js which 404s.
